entry.title: Dexed 2.0.2
entry.summary: **MPC OS 3.10.1 folder format.** Same plugin as dx7-v2.0.1 (binaries, skins and data byte-identical); the plugin folder now carries a `plugin.json`, so it can be copied straight into `VST2 Plugins` on MPC OS 3.10.1, and the new **`-mpc-sdk.zip`** is one folder for every MPC (Gen1, Gen2 and the Force). The Plugin Manager and the installer app install it on every MPC OS as before.

entry.title: Dexed 2.0.1
entry.summary: # Dexed (DX7) 2.0.1 **Fixed**: clicks and pops on note release (#18). 2.0's new front end split each audio block at every MIDI event and asked the engine for the pieces, but the DX7 engine only renders whole 64-sample blocks: given a shorter piece it still moved every voice on by 64 samples, so the waveform jumped at each note-off (and note-on). entry.title: Dexed 1.0.8
entry.summary: Plugin Manager: a "Your files" folder for your own DX7 .syx carts (dx7_carts), so you can upload carts from the manager's web page. No change to the sound or the skin.

entry.title: Dexed 1.0.7
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.
